issue_context.title: Incorrect unit for wind speed in SHMI integration
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The wind speed is reported to be in m/s in this integration, but as one can clearly tell from multiplying by 3.6 the published wind speed at the SMHI web page for the same location gives the same numbers as reported in home assistant SMHI integration. Thus, the integration is in fact presenting the wind speed in km/h instead of the claimed m/s. 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62025572/170874255-53f99ee8-47a7-4f0d-b89c-791eb80383fb.png)



### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.5.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

smhi

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/smhi

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

I believe the same issue plagues the met.no weather integration as well, as roughly the same wind speed is claimed to be in m/s when clearly the unit really is km/h.
